queries: WITH country_tallies AS (SELECT p.birth_country, COUNT(*) AS tally FROM player_college AS pc JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = pc.player_id WHERE p.birth_country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.birth_country), country_shares AS (SELECT birth_country, tally, tally * 1.0 / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share, AVG(tally * 1.0) OVER () AS average_tally FROM country_tallies) SELECT SUM(tally) AS combined_tally, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(tally - average_tally) AS average_amount_above_tally FROM country_shares WHERE tally > average_tally

WITH country_tallies AS (SELECT p.birth_country, COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_id) AS tally FROM player_college AS pc JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = pc.player_id WHERE p.birth_country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.birth_country), country_shares AS (SELECT birth_country, tally, tally * 1.0 / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share, AVG(tally * 1.0) OVER () AS average_tally FROM country_tallies) SELECT SUM(tally) AS combined_tally, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(tally - average_tally) AS average_amount_above_tally FROM country_shares WHERE tally > average_tally

WITH country_tallies AS (SELECT p.birth_country, COUNT(*) AS tally FROM player_college AS pc JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = pc.player_id WHERE p.birth_country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.birth_country), country_shares AS (SELECT birth_country, tally, CAST(tally AS REAL) / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share FROM country_tallies), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(tally) AS average_tally FROM country_tallies) SELECT SUM(cs.tally) AS combined_tally, AVG(cs.share) AS average_share, AVG(cs.tally - oa.average_tally) AS average_amount_above_tally FROM country_shares AS cs CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa WHERE cs.tally > oa.average_tally;
